# Cryptonic Area

> Cryptonic Area is a cybersecurity and technology company focused on building practical capabilities, delivering hands-on technical learning, and developing real-world solutions across the evolving digital landscape. We work at the intersection of cybersecurity, technology, and practical innovation, helping individuals and organizations strengthen their technical knowledge, security awareness, and ability to address real-world challenges. With a growing global presence across 40+ countries, Cryptonic Area is committed to empowering the next generation of digital defenders through practical execution, continuous learning, and technical excellence..

Founder and CEO: Karndeep Baror (Cyber Crime Investigator, Penetration Tester, Mentor, APT Intelligence).
Contact: info@cryptonicarea.site
